## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional commit messages; user-visible changes carry a `Release-note:` trailer (`Release-note: none` otherwise)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] UI changes: keyboard navigation and axe pass, and the states are handled (loading / empty / error / offline / view-only / permission-denied)
- [ ] No secrets, private hostnames, or third-party screenshots added
